purpose: Verify mathematical implementation and source assumptions before designing new calibration; no chip-fidelity certification.

paper_principle_control.extra_assumptions: No quantization or word saturation; last digital slope extends above raw 1.0; symmetric correction below zero. This is a principle-level consistency check, not exact Fig.6 reproduction.
paper_principle_control.acceptance: final grid dithered MSE < initial MSE/100, both coefficients within 0.02 of [1/0.96,1/0.8]; keep literal equation's 0.0008 discontinuity, do not silently repair source rounding

moment_controls.assumptions: Independent uniform residues and fresh independent binary dither, continuous one-slope memoryless model, window-frozen coefficients; excludes gates, quantization, clipping, dynamics and coupled stages.
moment_controls.acceptance: ensemble final mean within 5 predicted standard errors; relative variance error <= 8 percent. These checks concern the declared scalar model only.

source_freeze: Hash original architecture, platform, PWL, LMS, two-stage, four-lane and EXP-050 protocol before and after; source PDFs unchanged.
boundary: Inverse gains and actual inputs appear only in offline controls. No online algorithm or RTL modified. No tuned method or claimed holdout victory. Chip transfer, PRNG, timing and noise remain unverified.
